cryptoUsages.source: portal-impl/src/META-INF/util-spring.xml gives SHA-1 to the MessageDigestCacheKeyGenerator of PortletPreferencesFactoryImpl.

With FIPS mode off, EncryptorImpl.encryptUnencoded and EncryptorImpl.decryptUnencodedAsBytes use the algorithm of the key they are given: the company key (company.encryption.algorithm), the key of encrypted object fields (object.encryption.algorithm) or the tunnel key (tunneling.servlet.encryption.algorithm).
DefaultPasswordEncryptor digests passwords with the algorithm that passwords.encryption.algorithm names, or that passwords.encryption.algorithm.legacy names for passwords hashed before.

PBKDF2PasswordEncryptor computes PBKDF2 on the Mac that passwords.encryption.algorithm or passwords.encryption.algorithm.legacy names, for example HmacSHA1 for the default PBKDF2WithHmacSHA1/160/1300000.
PBKDF2PasswordEncryptor keys that Mac with the password, under the same Mac algorithm.
